capabilities: Runs an interactive shell in an embedded panel
Manages tabs with rename, color-coding, pinning and reordering
Opens terminals at the vault root, the current file's folder, or a right-clicked file
Inserts dragged file paths and pasted clipboard images into the shell
Restores tab names, colors, working directories and scrollback after restart
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.7.2+; the native terminal binary must be downloaded from the plugin settings after install. After minor or major updates a one-time in-app notice with a support link is shown, which can be turned off.
problem: Running shell commands while working in a vault means switching to a separate terminal window outside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Optional Claude Code integration: auto-maintained session registry with clickable Resume links and URI handler

summary: Embedded terminal panel that runs a real interactive shell inside Obsidian, with tabs, search and session restore.
